fields.description: The Greens is a four- and five-bedroom villa cluster within Sobha Sanctuary. Its Garden Villas and Courtyard Villas have different layouts, plot sizes and circulation: the five-bedroom examples span three levels and include a lift. The developer presents the neighbourhood around landscaped streets and everyday community facilities.

overview: The Greens connects homes to parks, play spaces and community activity. Four-bedroom layouts differ in maid and storage accommodation; compare the chosen type rather than assuming the larger corner-home specification applies to every villa.
research.locationNote: The own cluster page identifies Sobha Sanctuary and shows connections towards Dubai Rugby Sevens and the wider Dubai road network. No exact catalogue neighbourhood exists yet; nearby The Valley is not substituted as the project address.
research.priceNote: Property Finder publishes an AED 4m launch reference. Later broker prices sit above that historical guide and depend on the selected home. No current official price list or allocatable stock was verified.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% booking, 40% construction and 40% handover. Later Found material instead gives 20% booking, 20% construction and 60% handover. The displayed stages are the attributed portal reference; no variant is represented as a current signed offer.
research.handoverNote: The April 2026 developer investor snapshot lists 2029. Property Finder reports September 2029, while later Found material gives August/Q3 2030. No selected-unit contractual resolution was found.
